subject: POC onboarding & hands-on playbook — scheduling coordination
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@havenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC onboarding & hands-on playbook — scheduling coordination

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. We’re excited to get the HavenHealth POC started. The goal for the kickoff is to align stakeholders, validate success criteria, and run an initial hands-on session that exercises prompt routing and a short load test so we can baseline latency/cost. Proposed outcomes:
- Confirm stakeholder roles & acceptance criteria
- Validate prompt-set behavior across routing policies
- Run a controlled 5k-token load trial (sample traffic)
- Agree next steps and rollout options (Dedicated vs Hosted)

Proposed schedule (each item can be split across two meetings if you prefer):
1) 45-min Kickoff (stakeholders, goals, security asks)
2) 90-min Hands-on lab (prompt review, routing config, sample inference runs)
3) 30-min Results & next steps (metrics and rollout options)

Available slots next week (Pacific):
- Tue Feb 16: 09:00–11:30 or 14:00–17:00
- Wed Feb 17: 10:00–12:00
- Thu Feb 18: 13:00–17:00

Attachments: POC_Playbook_v1.pdf (agenda + checklist).

If you’d like, I can also schedule a short 15-minute preflight with our infra lead to confirm network/credentials before the hands-on.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Attachment: POC_Playbook_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@havenhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@havenhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC onboarding & hands-on playbook — scheduling coordination

Hi Priya —

Thanks — this looks good. Quick notes from my side:
- We’ll need to include our Security and Cloud Ops owners on the kickoff: Tom Reilly (cc’d) and our Security lead (TBD).
- We have limited windows the week of Feb 16 due to an internal migration. Best for us are:
  • Tue Feb 16: 16:00–17:30 ET (which is 13:00–14:30 PT)
  • Thu Feb 18: 09:00–11:00 ET (06:00–08:00 PT) — early but possible for some folks

Would prefer splitting the hands-on into a separate session later in the week if possible (we want the kickoff to focus on roles and acceptance criteria). Also, please share a short preflight checklist (network ranges, IAM role, sample prompts).

Elena
Director, Digital Platform
HavenHealth Corp
elena.morales@havenhealth.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@havenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onboarding & hands-on playbook — scheduling coordination

Thanks Elena — great constraints to know. Let’s plan for a focused kickoff (45 minutes) and then schedule the hands-on lab as a follow-up. Proposed plan: 

A) Kickoff (45 min) — goals: introductions, success criteria, security & compliance scope, and logistics- Proposed slot: Tue Feb 16 13:00–13:45 PT (that matches your 16:00–16:45 ET window)

B) Hands-on lab (90 min) — goals: prompt review, routing policy demo, short load trial (non-production traffic)- Proposed slot: Fri Feb 19 10:00–11:30 PT (or we can move this to next week if you prefer)

C) Preflight (15 min) — items to confirm: network whitelists, S3/role access for sample artifacts, and sample prompt set format. I recommend doing the preflight the day before the hands-on.

Attached: Lab_Instructions.md (quick runbook) and network_inventory_template.xlsx. Karthik (cc’d) will lead the hands-on from our side and can coordinate infra preflight.

If Tue 13:00 PT works for you, I’ll send updated calendar invites and a short agenda.

Cheers,
Priya
Attachment: Lab_Instructions.md (text)
Attachment: network_inventory_template.xlsx (Excel)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onboarding & hands-on playbook — scheduling coordination

Elena / Priya —

Quick follow-up from infra side. I’m available to run the preflight and will need the following before the 15-min call so we can be efficient: 
- Completed network_inventory_template.xlsx (IP ranges + proxy/VPN details)
- A temporary IAM role ARN with read access to the test bucket OR a short-lived S3 presigned URL for our sample artifacts
- Representative prompt set (5–10 prompts) and desired routing rules (e.g., high-priority -> small-model, fallback -> quantized)

Can we do a 15-min preflight on Wed Feb 17 at 09:30 PT? If that works, I’ll send the calendar invite and include checkboxes in the invite description for the above items.

On quoting the earlier plan: "If Tue 13:00 PT works for you, I’ll send updated calendar invites" — Tue works for me from Redwood side.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
